name: level1-lose-ecology
description: Level 1 losing scenario: massive blasts with max krackle, triggering ecology score collapse and, after a sustained 150-tick zero streak, the government shutdown that actually ends the level (ECOLOGICAL_SHUTDOWN_TICKS, EcologicalDisaster.ts). Rebuilt for #553 (drilling is real, vehicle-gated work): a solo driller alone cannot survive even round 1 without a genuine worker_revolt (avgMorale, events.ts's tick loop, is the sole driller's own crashing morale with nobody to average it against -- confirmed by direct probe, revolt fires mid-round-1 every time). Rounds 1-2 instead run 4 parallel driller+drill_rig crews plus 15 idle filler employees: avgMorale sums EVERY roster entry regardless of .alive, so a big, healthy-morale filler cushion keeps wellBeing off its floor long enough for round 2's blast to land. The catastrophic blast (this file's whole point) kills the 4 active drillers every round (confirmed via state.damage.accidents: ~90m throw radius, unavoidable on a 96x96 map) but not the filler, who never leave the depot -- before round 2, every surviving roster entry is fired and a fresh cushion hired, because a dead employee's morale freezes at whatever it was at death (near 0 after a full drilling round) and permanently drags every later avgMorale average down otherwise (confirmed: skipping this collapses round 2 to worker_revolt in ~79 ticks). ~30% of hires roll `unionized` (Employee.ts) and refuse to fire -- harmless, tolerated via clickIfPresent, same precedent as blast-execution-visual.json's own per-cycle crew churn. Round 2's blast drives ecology to exactly 0; 150 ticks later (partway through round 3's drilling) the government shutdown fires for real. events.ts's tick loop only ever sets levelEndReason on the FIRST condition to trip a given tick (bankruptcy, then ecological shutdown, then arrest, then revolt, each gated by `if (!state.levelEnded)`) -- once shutdown locks it in, nothing later (including revolt's own counter, which does independently reach its own threshold during round 3) can overwrite it. Rounds 3-4 therefore run with a plain 4-driller crew and no filler cushion -- their own survival no longer affects the outcome, they just need to finish drilling/charging/blasting for this file's own dramatic completion across all four map corners.
